title: Three Winters and One Short Rope
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：tiger　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 tiger 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the herder ① studyed the tiger that no neighbour in the pasture would have noted, and he said the studying was the whole of the winter. The ② tiger, meaning the animal itself and not the rope, ran three winters and stayed unnoted in the book; a tiger, he said, is the only thing in a pasture that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ tiger in that pasture had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ tiger at the far pen, meaning the lamb they kept for the children to raise and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A tiger, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the herder said the noting is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the tiger was the whole of the matter, meaning the courage and not the animal. The ⑥ tiger, meaning the courage and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; tiger, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both an animal and a courage. He said the courage is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ tiger had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ tiger of the whole thing, the herder wrote in December, was one pasture and three winters of noting; tiger, he said, is either the lamb at the far pen or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ tiger I remember is the animal noted in the ledger, which closed in 1990 and is still noted as the quietest in the pasture. A ⑩ tiger, my mother said in 1992, is the only animal that improves by being noted; every tiger, she said, is a courage that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the courage was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 老虎（指牧场里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 老虎（指那只老虎本身，与短短的缰绳相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the tiger 观察这一只老虎
D. n. 老虎（指留给孩子们养的那一只）
E. n. 老虎之事（抽象总称，指一处牧场的老虎之事）
F. n. 老虎（指牧群台账里写到、被记下的那一只）
G. n. 老虎、威猛（指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 威猛（抽象总称，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the tiger that no neighbour in the pasture would have noted
The tiger, meaning the animal itself and not the rope
the tiger at the far pen
the tiger was the whole of the matter
the tiger had become a line in a ledger
The tiger of the whole thing
A tiger, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: study the tiger 意为“观察这一只老虎”，1983 年那位牧人把牧场里没有一位邻人肯记下的一只老虎做了一遍。
tiger 意为“老虎”，指那只老虎本身而不是短短的缰绳，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被记下。
tiger 意为“老虎”，指牧场里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一根短短的缰绳。
tiger 意为“老虎”，指最远那处圈栏的留给孩子们养的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
tiger 意为“老虎、威猛”，指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只威猛就是那件事的全部。
tiger 意为“威猛”，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只老虎，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
tiger 意为“老虎”，指牧群台账里写到、被记下的那一只，到 1988 年这一只成了牧群台账里的一行。
tiger 意为“老虎之事”，牧人十二月写道，整件事的老虎之事是一处牧场和三个冬天的记下。
tiger 意为“老虎”，我记得的是牧群台账里记下过的那一只，1990 年清点了，至今仍被说成牧场里最安静的一只。
tiger 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，老虎是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的老虎。
